correctness.rationale: Each strict four-letter itinerary specifies an affine equation (I-M_w)z=c_w. If that equation is singular, no solution is isolated on its open strict-itinerary region. For an isolated primitive period-four orbit a word with symbolic period one or two is impossible: the shorter affine return commutes with its 4/d iterate and uniqueness of a nonsingular fixed point forces shorter actual period. Exactly three aperiodic binary necklaces remain, so universal bound three. At (tauL,deltaL,tauR,deltaR)=(1,-7/4,-7/4,3/5), an independently written Fraction-based reconstruction solved all 16 affine equations, obtained 16 different strict roots, identified 2 fixed/2 period-two/12 period-four points, and reproduced monodromy traces -377/80, 1187/320, -171/400 and determinants -1029/320,441/400,-189/500. Hyperbolicity and strict inequalities persist by continuity; complete no-switching-line census follows from availability of an assigned word at each zero x.
